author: Good Enough
description:
In the late 1800s, Clark Stanley claimed his rattlesnake fat liniment could cure everything from arthritis to sprains. Crowds bought into the hype, until the government exposed it as a total fraud. This short dives into how one man’s scam gave birth to the phrase we still use today: "snake oil"
